fact: On 26 April 2024 ONIP resumed issuing national identity cards and mass identification in the Kinshasa pilot communes of Bandalungwa, Lingwala, Limete and N'sele, with each Congolese to receive a unique identification number.
title: RDC : lancement de l'opération d'octroi des cartes d'identité et de l'identification de masse
